title: Why this failed
purpose: Click a failed test → follow evidence chain to root cause
payoff: Shows causal nav ("Why?") beats transcript scrolling
narration: When a test fails, don't scroll through logs. Click the failure, hit Why, and follow the evidence chain to the root cause.

title: Live while it runs
purpose: Watch a turn appear, expand its phase cluster, see failure flash
narration: The map updates live as the agent works. Watch structure form, expand a phase cluster, see a failure flash — all while the agent is still running.

title: Drill into subagent
purpose: Double-click subagent node → inspect its map → return to parent
narration: Double-click any subagent to enter its own map. Inspect its work, then return to the parent at the exact same place. Context preserved.

title: Share the decision
purpose: Copy permalink → paste in PR → reviewer lands on exact node
narration: Copy a deep link to any decision. Paste it in a PR, and your reviewer lands on the exact node, at the exact layout level. No context lost.

title: Overview to execution
purpose: Show the three levels: Overview → Execution → Detail
payoff: Demonstrates spatial navigation across abstraction levels
narration: Three levels, one keystroke apart. Overview shows the whole session structure. Execution reveals turn-by-turn detail. Detail gives you the full diff without leaving the map.

title: Layout tour
purpose: Quick tour of Timeline, Hierarchy, Tree, Force, Ribbon, Matrix layouts
payoff: Shows each layout reveals different structure
narration: Each layout answers a different question. Timeline for temporal flow. Hierarchy for delegations. Tree for nested structure. Force for organic clusters. Ribbon for quick scanning. Matrix for tool patterns.

title: 3D depth modes
purpose: Show Orbit, Layered, Depth Stack 3D modes
narration: Three 3D modes for spatial exploration. Orbit for free rotation. Layered stacks turns by depth. Depth stack adds perspective fade with cards facing the camera. Perspective shows detail at extreme angles.

title: Search and filter
purpose: Show keyword search, NLQ, and trust lens
narration: Search by keyword, or use natural language — "failed tools" compiles to the right filter. The trust lens flags outputs that were never verified by tests.

title: Files and hybrid view
purpose: Show changed files rail and hybrid split view
payoff: Demonstrates file context and transcript+map together
narration: Toggle the files rail to see every modification with diffs a click away. Hybrid view puts the transcript and map side by side, linked by selection.

title: Responsive and themes
purpose: Show narrow viewport, light theme, zoom levels
narration: Responsive design collapses the toolbar on narrow screens. Full light and dark theme support. Semantic zoom keeps labels crisp at 150%, and max zoom reveals full detail without leaving the map.
